description: code-review-harness guardrails + status Mod. Strict only while a review is active (CODE_REVIEW_ACTIVE=1 from /review-run, or <cwd>/.code-review/active.json from a manual stage): Edit/Write only inside the review dir and never on script-owned files; a Bash seatbelt against mutating git, installs, in-place edits and writes into the source tree; agent outputs (raw shards, votes, topology, architecture) validated on write. Outside a review the hooks do nothing. The Mod (register.ts) renders status.json in the spinner and via /review-dashboard. No telemetry.
